From 8ddec8b82f90652182cb7eddb7aa841e4fa4e639 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Morris Jette <jette@schedmd.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jul 2013 16:29:10 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] Fix for batch job CPU count if --ntasks-per-node specified

and max_nodes == min_nodes or no max_nodes specified
bug introduced in commit 1b7f5b91c18e747dd4a27fc1f64c000f04e78669
fix for bug 343

diff --git a/src/sbatch/opt.c b/src/sbatch/opt.c
index 7101b7b412..57cb0803c4 100644
--- a/src/sbatch/opt.c
+++ b/src/sbatch/opt.c
@@ -2145,7 +2145,7 @@ static bool _opt_verify(void)
 				      opt.overcommit, 0);
 
 	if ((opt.ntasks_per_node > 0) && (!opt.ntasks_set) &&
-	    (opt.max_nodes == 0)) {
+	    ((opt.max_nodes == 0) || (opt.min_nodes == opt.max_nodes))) {
 		opt.ntasks = opt.min_nodes * opt.ntasks_per_node;
 		opt.ntasks_set = 1;
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `src/sbatch/opt.c`**
   - The conditional statement that checks if `opt.ntasks_per_node` is greater than 0 and `opt.ntasks_set` is not set has been modified. 
   - The original condition `(opt.max_nodes == 0)` has been changed to `((opt.max_nodes == 0) || (opt.min_nodes == opt.max_nodes))`. 
   - This change allows the calculation of `opt.ntasks` to occur not only when `max_nodes` is zero but also when `min_nodes` is equal to `max_nodes`.

### Relationships

- The modification in `src/sbatch/opt.c` addresses a bug that was introduced in a previous commit (1b7f5b91c18e747dd4a27fc1f64c000f04e78669) related to the handling of CPU counts for batch jobs when specific parameters (`--ntasks-per-node`, `max_nodes`, and `min_nodes`) are set. 
- By expanding the condition to include the scenario where `min_nodes` equals `max_nodes`, the patch ensures that the CPU count is correctly calculated in cases where the number of nodes is fixed, thus fixing the bug referenced (bug 343).
